committee: Invitation Mes CHamoru Month Meet and Greet Kick-Off - Office of Senator Shelly Calvo
title: Buenas yan Håfa Adai! Senator Shelly V. Calvo, Chairwoman of the Committee on Culture and Historic Preservation, is honored to invite you to the 38th Guam Legislature Mes CHamoru Celebration , a special occasion to unite our community in honoring our island's rich heritage and culture. This year’s celebration is more than a program — it is an opportunity to meet and greet one another, to share stories, laughter, food, and fellowship, and to collectively honor the rich heritage, language, and traditions that continue to shape our island.
